narrativeProgression.description: Question about who goes to hell.
Description of those who go to hell through their actions: "Their thoughts were evil continuously".
First reason for going to hell: Rebelling against God while claiming to be God's chosen people.
Second reason: Creating their own gods and going back to their old sins.
Third reason: Rejecting God's prophet and authority.

Snakes are shown.
People dance in a dark environment.

trimmingSuggestions.description: The extended logo animation could be shortened to increase the dynamism.

The black and white scenes with distorted sound could be cut as they are not visually engaging and don't add significant information.

youtube_description: Hell is real and folks are going! The Truth Behind Hip Hop 12: Outer Darkness, is a message of eternal relevance, that will open the eyes of those that claim their allegiance to Christ while testing the faith of those within the Kingdom of God. Over the centuries, there has been confusion surrounding the existence of a literal and eternal hell. This viewpoint has affected our perspective of life’s consequences within the body of Christ, and even caused some to believe that, although being fully aware of its presence, a believer would never be at risk of ending up there. This presentation boldly confronts the age-old controversy with astounding biblical evidence that extinguishes any doubts of the existence of hell.  Download or order at: digital.exministries.com
